title: Nimbus briefing microcard: compact per-route & per-model telemetry specs
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Goal: Define a compact 'Nimbus' microcard component for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-route and per-model performance signals in dense operational surfaces (briefings, sidebars, and compact boards). The microcard must show key metrics at-a-glance (p50/p90 latency, rps throughput, token-per-request, token-cost estimate) and allow quick drill actions (open route, open model variant, open token drilldown).
visual_specs_summary: Microcard footprint: 320x112px (min 280x96 responsive). Primary row: route name + model badge (left). Right-aligned mini-sparkline for latency (p50 in solid, p90 dashed). Secondary row: three compact pills: RPS (numeric with trend chevron), TPR (tokens/request), Cost (USD est with hover breakdown). Token flow icon toggles between 'live' and 'cached' states. Color tokens: success/neutral/warning for thresholds. Micro-interactions include hover tooltip with 7-day distribution sparkline and click-to-expand modal with full charts.
chart_specs: Latency sparkline: 88x24 px, stacked area for p50/p90, p50 fill #1F77B4, p90 stroke #FF7F0E dashed, y-domain adaptive but annotated with absolute p90 value on hover
Throughput bar micro: 72x24 px horizontal bars per minute aggregated, stacked color segments for model variants when present, tooltip shows per-variant RPS and 95th percentile latency
Token-rate radial micro: 40px circle showing avg tokens/request with inner label; arc color maps to token-cost bands (green/yellow/red), accessible text provided for screen readers
Cost overlay: on hover, an accordion reveals per-token cost calc: base model cost + quantization discount + caching savings (estimated in USD), uses monospace table layout

Latency waterfall (expand modal): vertical waterfall with swimlanes for queue, compute, KV-cache hit/miss. Each bar labeled with ms and % of total. Allows time-range scrubber to inspect a request trace sample
interactions_and_rollouts: Compact toggle: users can pin microcards to a briefing board; pinning persists per-user in Console settings
Rollout knob: beta users can opt-in to 'dense telemetry' which surfaces additional micro-indicators (cache hit icon, quantization flag). Rollout controlled via feature-flag/console-roles
Fallback behavior: when telemetry is missing, microcard shows skeletons and a single-line status message that links to diagnostics
Accessibility: all charts must expose alt text and numeric summaries; colorblind-friendly palette and 2px minimum stroke widths
acceptance_criteria: Design files delivered: Figma components for microcard, expanded modal, and tooltip flows
Specs include exact pixel sizes, color tokens, spacing tokens, and interaction timing (hover 120ms, expand animation 180ms)
Engineering-ready chart kit: spec for sparklines, micro-bars, and radial tokens with data contracts for latency/throughput/token-cost fields
Review sign-off from PM (Olivia Park) and Eng lead (Marcus Ng) recorded in comments
decisions: Single-line token-cost estimate uses 7-day rolling avg for tokens/request to avoid spike noise
Show both p50 and p90 on the micro sparkline to preserve signal for tail latency without large visual weight
Cache hit indicator will appear as a micro-pill only when backend provides >50% cache telemetry to avoid misleading icons
